question: Who has become the ﬁrst Woman DGP of Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R Sreelekha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ms. Sreelekha, belonging to the 1987 batch, is the first woman officer to be elevated as a DGP**__.

 __
 
• The Cabinet elevated Additional Directors General of Police Sankar Reddy and R. Sreelekha to the post of Director Generals of Police.
 
• The government has posted Ms. Sreelekha, the first woman IPS officer in the State, as the Director-General, Fire and Rescue Department. 
 
• Ms. Sreelekha, belonging to the 1987 batch, is the first woman officer to be elevated as a DGP.
 
 
• She is due for retirement in December.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Mr. Reddy **has been posted as the Road Safety Commissioner. DGPs Jacob Thomas and A. Hemachandran are due for retirement on May 31.
 
• **R. Sreelekha** is an officer in the Indian Police Service and the First Lady Officer of the IPS from Kerala, India.
 
 
• Sreelekha is also an author and now running a successful YouTube channel- “**SASNEHAM SREELEKHA**” to share her experiences as a police officer
